baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form VI plural يَتَسَاءَلُونَ after the contracted interrogative عَمَّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reciprocal form distributes asking across a group: each participant is both source and recipient, while عَمَّ withholds their shared object.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies a horizontal exchange in which the group keeps one absent topic circulating.

changed_reading.before: Several people happen to ask about something.
changed_reading.after: A group sustains a reciprocal circuit of questioning around one deliberately withheld object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted عَمَّ opens an object-slot for يَتَسَاءَلُونَ without yet filling it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch image of a sought request makes the interrogative gap function as a shared demand for an answer, not merely a neutral topic label.

activation_trace.role: The sought request turns the omitted object into something pursued through the exchange.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks only what subject people mention.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a collective pursuit whose missing object presses for resolution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet split-maps focus يَتَسَاءَلُونَ not only to س ء ل but also to the non-dominant target س ل ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The distant target overlays reciprocal speech with linked extraction: one question gently draws concealed matter out, and another carries the process onward.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out supplies an extraction image for what questioning does to concealed matter.
Chainlike connection makes successive reciprocal questions links in one disclosure process.

changed_reading.before: The plural verb denotes ordinary mutual questioning.
changed_reading.after: The exchange can be carried experimentally as linked pulls that bring hidden matter into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The withheld object is immediately recast as a report that comes and is transmitted, with enough magnitude to generate repeated circulation rather than a casual query.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the social relay whose object and pressure the next ayah specify.
An arriving, delivered report fills the interrogative gap and gives the exchange transmissive motion.
Magnitude and force explain why this report dominates the group's attention.

structural_cues: 78:2 immediately answers the fronted عَمَّ with عَنِ النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ.
The opening question and its supplied object repeat the preposition عَنْ across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered report and magnitude; I infer that arrival plus weight drives its social relay, while the live alternative is that 78:2 only names an already disputed topic.

changed_reading.before: A group seeks an unspecified answer.
changed_reading.after: A consequential report has entered the group and now travels through reciprocal questioning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocity no longer implies cooperation: participants take divergent routes around the report, while the doubled future knowing imposes a temporal endpoint on their competing positions.

activation_trace.role: Mutual questioning provides one shared speech-space that can contain opposed stances.
Each taking a route unlike the other's converts exchange into divergence rather than joint inquiry.
Coming disclosure to the knower supplies the first promised closure of uncertainty.
The repeated disclosure intensifies certainty and limits the duration of dispute.

structural_cues: 78:3 keeps the same plural group but predicates disagreement of them.
78:4-5 repeat كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ with ثُمَّ marking a second stage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent routes and twice-promised disclosure; I infer that some opening questions enact position-taking, though genuine inquiry can remain mixed into the same exchange.

changed_reading.before: Reciprocal asking is a cooperative search for information.
changed_reading.after: The same reciprocal form stages a contested field whose rival positions will be closed by disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first assigns stable and habitable states, includes daily cutting-off in sleep, then displaces the same solid mountains into mirage. This makes reconfiguration of familiar states a material answer to the incredulity carried by the opening exchange.

activation_trace.role: Asking supplies the unresolved issue whose feasibility the sequence of made and unmade states addresses.
Causing a thing to assume a state establishes state-change as the sequence's governing operation.
Preparation and leveling present the earth's habitability as an arranged state rather than a fixed given.
Elevated solid mass supplies the strongest image of apparent permanence.
Peg-like upright fixity turns mountains into an explicit stabilizing mechanism.
Cutting and removal make ordinary sleep a recurring interruption within the made order.
Displacement and removal reverse the earlier stabilization.
The same solid mass now becomes the substrate of reversal, sharpening the before-and-after contrast.
A mirage shining like water replaces solidity with deceptive appearance.

structural_cues: 78:6-13 repeatedly use first-person making and building before 78:17 announces the threshold event.
Mountains recur in 78:7 and 78:20, first as pegs and later as displaced mirage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arranged stability, recurrent interruption, and later removal; I infer that reconfigurability answers feasibility implicit in the dispute, while the alternative is that these are adjacent signs without a direct argumentative arrow to 78:1.

changed_reading.before: The group asks what the report is.
changed_reading.after: Their exchange also exposes doubt about whether the familiar world's assigned states can be radically reassigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Compression releases a downpour, and the purpose-linked result brings seed and growth out from concealment. That material extraction activates the focus split-target image of questioning as a gentle drawing-out process.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out gives the focus exchange an explicitly exploratory extraction image.
Pressure until liquid is released supplies the first mechanical stage of extraction.
Pouring and outflow carry the released material toward its productive result.
Bringing a thing out of hiding names the emergence that the material process causes.
The seed that germinates supplies a compact latent object waiting to be drawn out.
Growth emerging from earth completes the concealed-to-manifest mechanism.

structural_cues: The purpose construction لِنُخْرِجَ in 78:15 explicitly links the poured water of 78:14 to emergence.
Grain, vegetation, and entwined gardens expand the result from compact seed to visible abundance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, outflow, hidden emergence, seed, and growth; I map that causal sequence onto the non-dominant focus extraction branch, while ordinary س ء ل questioning remains the live and lexically nearer alternative.

changed_reading.before: Questioning only exchanges already formulated propositions.
changed_reading.after: Questioning can be carried as a process that draws a latent answer from concealment into articulated form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The answer to the exchange takes event-form: a fixed appointment separates claims and brings the plural questioners themselves as arriving groups. Resolution is enacted rather than merely stated.

activation_trace.role: The opening group exchanges questions; the later event changes what counts as their answer.
A severe occurring day gives the disputed object concrete event-character.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the operation that resolves opposed claims.
A fixed appointment gives the resolution a non-negotiable temporal boundary.
Coming and arrival move the people from discussing the event to entering it.
Groups of people preserve the opening plurality while changing it from talk-circle to assembled cohorts.

structural_cues: 78:17 begins with إِنَّ and identifies the event as a fixed appointment.
78:18 shifts from third-person questioners to second-person plural فَتَأْتُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointed separation and group arrival; I infer that enacted adjudication is the answer-form to 78:1, though the alternative is to read it only as later description of the report's content.

changed_reading.before: The opening seeks a verbal proposition that will settle discussion.
changed_reading.after: The settlement is an appointed event that separates claims and gathers the discussants inside its answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and lack of expectation characterize the speakers' side of the exchange, but exhaustive counting and durable writing produce a record to which recompense corresponds. Their talk cannot control the account.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal speech supplies the human account that the later enumeration tests independently.
Answering an act with its recompense establishes consequence as a response mechanism.
A measure equal to its counterpart makes the response correspond to what precedes it.
Heartfelt expectation, negated in the ayah, identifies refusal to anticipate the account.
Counting and reckoning name the evaluative process the speakers fail to expect.
Contradiction of truth turns at least part of the opening circulation into resistant counter-speech.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration closes the omissions available to human discussion.
Ordered written marks give the exhaustive count a durable form outside the speakers' claims.

structural_cues: 78:26-29 moves causally from corresponding recompense, through non-expectation and denial, to exhaustive recording.
The emphatic verbal noun كِذَّابًا intensifies the contrast between spoken denial and the written account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, failed expectation, count, record, and corresponding recompense; I infer that the opening exchange is under audit, while the alternative is that some questioners are merely curious and not identical with those later described.

changed_reading.before: The group debates which verbal account is correct.
changed_reading.after: Their competing accounts are themselves subordinate to an exhaustive record that returns acts as consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening permits horizontal, self-propelled exchange; the closing scene removes mixed noise, denies control over address, and admits only permitted, correct speech. The issue becomes who may speak and under what truth-condition, not only what is asked.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies unrestricted horizontal turn-taking for the later speech regime to invert.
Audible sound supplies the reception channel that the negated clause clears of corrupt speech.
Mixed vocal clamor supplies the noisy speech mode explicitly absent from the destination scene.
Ownership and power of disposal, negated here, remove autonomous control over address.
Conversational address directly recalls the opening exchange but places it under denied ownership.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the act now restricted by exception.
Permission supplies the gate that determines who may break the silence.
Correctness settled opposite error supplies the quality condition for admitted speech.

structural_cues: The surah opens with reciprocal plural speech but closes with لَا يَمْلِكُونَ, لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ, and an إِلَّا exception.
78:35 removes both idle speech and denial before 78:37-38 regulate address itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent clamor, denied control of address, permission, and correctness; I infer a deliberate inversion of the opening speech scene, while the alternative is that the closing restrictions describe a separate assembly without commenting on 78:1's exchange.

changed_reading.before: People freely question one another until someone supplies an answer.
changed_reading.after: Their free exchange anticipates a forum where speech is no longer theirs to control and an answer must be both permitted and correct.

context_deltas.mechanism: What begins as second-hand reciprocal speech ends in direct sight of what each person sent ahead by hand. A chosen return-route and embodied prior action make the question self-implicating: the person has been composing the answer in deeds.

activation_trace.role: Mutual questioning supplies mediated knowledge that the final direct seeing supersedes.
Reality fixed against falsehood makes the disputed report no longer negotiable.
Acquiring or adopting turns a possible return-route into a person's own committed course.
Return to a destination gives that adopted course an endpoint.
Warning that awakens caution converts information into a demand for present response.
Temporal nearness compresses the distance between questioning and encounter.
Directed sight or insight replaces hearsay with personal apprehension.
Advancing something forward makes prior action arrive before its actor as evidence.
What the two hands earned makes embodied deeds the object finally inspected.

structural_cues: 78:39 changes the report into ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ and immediately opens a conditional route of response.
78:40 opposes the opening's reciprocal hearsay to singular يَنظُرُ and the visible result of one's own hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed reality, an adopted return-route, near warning, sight, and deeds sent ahead; I infer that action has been answering the opening question, while the alternative is that deeds determine consequence without semantically answering the question.

changed_reading.before: The great matter is an external topic passed among speakers.
changed_reading.after: The matter addresses each speaker personally because prior embodied action becomes the answer each one must see.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it leans on the non-dominant س ل ل target of the focus root and crosses speech, clothing, architecture, sight, and belief. It remains anchored in the packet's focus drawing-out branch and in an ordered covering-to-opening-to-seeing mechanism; downstream prose should mark it as a disclosure analogy, not an etymology of يَتَسَاءَلُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus يَتَسَاءَلُونَ is packet-mapped to the exploratory image of gently drawing a hidden thing out.

activation_trace.role: Hidden drawing-out supplies the focus-side mechanism of progressive disclosure.
Covering by a garment gives concealment a material state early in the sequence.
Unclosing by insight or relief turns concealment into disclosure at the event threshold.
Directed sight completes the movement from hidden report to personally visible evidence.
Covering the truth identifies resistance to the disclosure process at its final human pole.

changed_reading.before: The opening is simply an exchange about an unknown subject.
changed_reading.after: The exchange tentatively initiates a disclosure arc in which covered truth is drawn out until it becomes unavoidable sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it builds from the focus plural construction and a cross-root social sequence rather than a direct lexical relation. It remains anchored in reciprocal questioning and is sharpened by groups, ranks, and the two packet-backed ت ر ب images of peer equality and dust; downstream prose should present it only as a structural social echo, not as identification of the opening speakers with every later group.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reciprocal plural يَتَسَاءَلُونَ initially presents the speakers as a horizontal peer network.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the initial horizontal relation among plural participants.
Groups of people reassemble the opening plurality into differentiated cohorts.
Equality in age and companionship supplies one realized form of peer relation.
Alignment on a level row replaces conversational reciprocity with ordered formation.
Earth and dust supply the other terminal image of leveling desired by the final speaker.

changed_reading.before: The plural marks only several people talking together.
changed_reading.after: Their horizontal question-circle becomes the first social configuration in a sequence that regroups, aligns, rewards peerhood, and ends with a wish for material leveling.

strongest_changes: The omitted object becomes an arriving, weighty report whose circulation has already divided the speakers.
The report's answer is enacted as appointed separation and group arrival rather than supplied only as a proposition.
Exhaustive record, corresponding recompense, and direct sight of one's deeds move the opening from information exchange to personal accountability.
The final permission-and-correctness regime inverts the opening scene of freely reciprocal speech.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the opening speech act itself traceable across the surah: free mutual questioning narrows into dispute, material demonstration, audited action, and finally authorized speech. The packet's split focus mapping also kept a form-distant extraction/disclosure reading visible without displacing the dominant reciprocal-questioning model.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening exchange may combine genuine inquiry, polemical challenge, and resistant denial; the packet does not force one speaker posture.
The non-dominant س ل ل mapping is productive as an extraction analogy but remains too form-distant to state as lexical meaning.
The made-world and growth sequences may directly answer feasibility implicit in the dispute, or may function only as adjacent evidence whose argumentative arrow is reader-supplied.
